text.hi: कुछ चीज़ें हम गिनते नहीं, जैसे bread, chalk, furniture, information, knowledge, luggage, paper, soap। इनके साथ ‘s’ नहीं लगता। ‘two breads’ गलत है।
text.hinglish: Kuch cheezein hum ginte nahi, jaise bread, chalk, furniture, information, knowledge, luggage, paper, soap. Inke saath ‘s’ nahi lagta. ‘two breads’ galat hai.
text.en: Some things we don't count, like bread, chalk, furniture, information, knowledge, luggage, paper and soap. They don't take ‘s’. ‘Two breads’ is wrong.

text.hi: गिनना हो तो टुकड़े का शब्द लगाओ: a slice of bread (ब्रेड का एक टुकड़ा), a cake of soap (साबुन की एक टिकिया), a sheet of paper (कागज़ का एक पन्ना), a piece of chalk (चॉक का एक टुकड़ा)।
text.hinglish: Ginna ho to tukde ka shabd lagao: a slice of bread (bread ka ek tukda), a cake of soap (saabun ki ek tikiya), a sheet of paper (kaagaz ka ek panna), a piece of chalk (chalk ka ek tukda).
text.en: To count them, add a word for the piece: a slice of bread, a cake of soap, a sheet of paper, a piece of chalk.

text.hi: किताब के उदाहरण: Please give me a slice of bread. Wash your hands well before and after meals with a cake of soap.
text.hinglish: Kitaab ke udaharan: Please give me a slice of bread. Wash your hands well before and after meals with a cake of soap.
text.en: Examples from the book: Please give me a slice of bread. Wash your hands well before and after meals with a cake of soap.
